text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Moooom~! I'm already bored of this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's going on here~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Sky-senpai~ listen to this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see. Since you slacked off on 
basic training, you're being subjected to 
a week in basic training hell.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, I don't really think I need the 
basics in the first place~. I mean, I'm a 
genius, aren't I~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And yet, like, seriously. It's totally 
impossible. Sky-senpai, do something about 
this~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho. Asked for a favor by a genius, are 
meow?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Maybe I can offer you a little time 
to catch your breath?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
?? What do you mean? Does that mean we get 
more breaks in between?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. That's something to look forward 
to once we actually try it~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what Sky-senpai meant 
yesterday. Training started up normally 
today, though.

Fusaichi Pandora starts running. It's a 
completely normal, basic training routine. 
...And yet.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Pfft! Wait, what is this?!

On the pylons placed around the track, my 
friends' faces were plastered large and 
clear. Along with a little message.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Pandora-chan! Picture yourself being 
strong! You're tomorrow's protagonist!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how strong or talented you are, 
you must never run away from the basics. 
Even when it's tough, let's do our best. I 
won't lose either."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: How is it? Everyone pitched in to help.

A massive close-up of a face was plastered 
right there, with a comic-style speech 
bubble next to it. The whole visual was 
just so absurdly surreal...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, success. Looks pretty fun, 
doesn't it?
choice_data_list:
I wonder if they're really able to 
concentrate like that...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"It's alright, no worries. Shoulders 
relaxed, feeling good~. Alright, on to the 
next one♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was fun... Could this be 
that 'quick breather' you were talking 
about yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I gotta text Sky-senpai that I totally 
laughed my head of... —!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
My wallpaper turned into Bright-senpai 
making a funny face――?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait, it's cute. But wait, a funny 
face... No, this is her struggling to make 
a funny face! Why is it still so cute, 
though?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, when I casually asked to see your 
phone, I secretly changed it.
choice_data_list: Are you working on anything else?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I think I set up about five more.

Rather than a breather, this is 
practically a prank. Even so, it's 
surprisingly elaborate.

Afterward, the harmless little pranks that 
brought bursts of laughter continued—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sky-senpai! That was seriously so much 
fun. Super grateful, honestly!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I couldn't help looking around to 
see where the prank was hidden~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It was just our usual basic training, but 
it was so fun! Thanks a bunch♡

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, it's too early to thank me yet~ 
There's still one more left, after all~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, for real!? Where, where?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If you don't find it on your own, half the 
fun is lost... you know?

For a while after that, Fusaichi Pandora 
seemed to search for pranks to pull, but 
found none.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Tch~. In the end, I couldn't find it. 
Guess I'll ask Sky-senpai again 
tomorrow—...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...This is...

On the desk lay a photo collection of 
today's pranks, along with handwritten 
short messages from the Umamusume who 
helped out.

"Good work!" "Good luck tomorrow too!" 
"We're cheering for you!" —And finally,
"Got you fired up now, didn't I~?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, she really pulled it off. I mean, 
this is basically a whole surprise party. 
Is Sky-senpai a genius or what?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
They're such good kids for playing along 
with a prank like this.
choice_data_list: Sky did a good thing too, huh? I'm moved.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Having things like this really gets you 
motivated, doesn't it? Like, what if we 
had stuff like this on a regular basis~?
choice_data_list:
...Are you trying to say something 
indirectly?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No, no, nothing at all~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm hoping some kind trainer 
out there will work hard for Sei-chan's 
sake or anything, you know?

"I'm looking forward to it," Seiun Sky 
said with a smile, looking this way with 
eyes full of anticipation...

"Were you showing me an example... so I'd 
do it for you too...?" I ask in an 
involuntarily trembling voice, and—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nihi~ Man, I'm already looking forward to 
seeing what kind of prank our deeply moved 
Trainer is gonna pull on us, nya~?

And so, Seiun Sky's little prank—under the 
guise of blowing off steam—ended in great 
success.
